DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お渡しした書類で、ご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about the documents we gave you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中の文字を読みたいと思いましたが、封を開けないよう書いてあります。まだ切っていません。開けずに内容の説明を聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未開封の提出封筒を開けずに説明を聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to read the text inside, but it says not to open the envelope. I haven't cut it open yet. Could you explain its contents without opening it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can hear an explanation without opening the sealed submission envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの封筒は、提出先の条件に合わせてお渡ししています。読み方は別の案内で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We provide this envelope in accordance with the recipient's requirements. Let's check how to read the document using a separate guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。まず、受け取った書類の名前を教えてください。提出先から届いた案内と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取書類名を聞き提出先の案内と比べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. First, could you tell me the name of the document I received? I'd like to compare it with the instructions from the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the document's name and say you want to compare it with the recipient's instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えに書類名があります。提出先からの案内もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The document's name is on your copy. Do you also have the instructions from the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらが提出先の案内です。控えの書類名と同じか、一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先資料を提示して控えの書類名との照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are their instructions. Could you help me check whether the document name matches the one on my copy?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the recipient's instructions and ask for help matching the document name to your copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類名は、二つの資料で一致していますね。ほかに確認したい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The document names match in the two materials. Is there anything else you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限も確認したいです。この案内の「必着」という言葉がよく分からないので、提出先へ質問しようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限欄の必着が不明で提出先へ質問すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd also like to check the deadline. I don't quite understand the phrase “must arrive by” in these instructions, so I plan to ask the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not understand “must arrive by” in the deadline section and will ask the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 提出期限と受渡し方は、提出先の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the recipient's instructions for the submission deadline and delivery method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 種類は確認できました。封を開けずに持ち帰り、期限と届け方を提出先に聞いてから送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種類確認後も未開封で保ち期限と届け方を確認して送ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed the type of document. I'll take it home unopened and send it after asking the recipient about the deadline and how to deliver it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep it sealed after confirming its type, check the deadline and delivery method, then send it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒と控えをなくさずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep the envelope and your copy safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査前の確認票について、分からない所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you don't understand on the pre-test checklist?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝食なしと書きましたが、今朝は甘いコーヒーを飲みました。飲食の欄で、そのことも伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝食なし記入でも甘いコーヒーを飲んだと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote that I had no breakfast, but I drank sweet coffee this morning. I'd like to mention that in the food and drink section too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Add that you drank sweet coffee despite writing that you had no breakfast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何を、何時ごろ飲まれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What did you drink, and at about what time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 七時ごろ、甘い缶コーヒーを一本飲みました。食べ物は口にしていませんが、飲み物のことを書き忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 七時の甘い缶コーヒー一本を飲み記入を忘れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At about seven, I drank one can of sweet coffee. I haven't eaten anything, but I forgot to write down the drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you drank one can of sweet coffee at seven and forgot to record it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査の担当へ、飲んだ物と時刻をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the person responsible for the test what you drank and when.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。缶の表示を写真に撮ってあるので、お見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲用物の表示写真を提示できると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I took a photo of the label on the can, so I can show you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to show a photo of the drink's label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 検査前の案内は、お手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the pre-test instructions with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内はこちらです。飲み物ならよいと思ってしまいました。今日の検査をどうするか、担当の方に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 事前案内を示し自己判断で飲んだため検査の扱いを担当へ確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here they are. I mistakenly thought drinks were allowed. Could you check with the person in charge what should happen with today's test?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the advance instructions and ask staff to check how to handle the test because you drank based on your own judgment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで担当の確認をお待ちください。案内と缶の表示もご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait here while we check with the person in charge. Have the instructions and the can's label ready too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内と写真を用意して待ちます。問診票のどこに追記するかも、担当の方の説明を聞いてから直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料をそろえ待ち問診票の追記方法も担当に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have the instructions and photo ready and wait. I'll also wait for their explanation of where to add the information on the medical questionnaire before correcting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will prepare the materials, wait, and ask the person in charge how to add the information to the questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その情報を検査の担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass that information to the person responsible for the test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の内容を、お話しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me what you'd like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車の近くに人がいたというメモを持ってきました。ただ、その文は友人が見たと話した内容で、私が見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人物の文は本人目撃でなく友人から聞いた内容と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought a note saying someone was near my car. But that sentence describes what a friend told me they saw, not something I saw myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the statement about the person: it came from a friend, not your own eyewitness account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身では、何を確認されましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が見たのは、その後の車の傷です。誰がいたか、何をしていたかは見ていません。自分が目撃したように書いた所を訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人は後の車の傷だけ見たと範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only saw the scratches on the car afterward. I didn't see who was there or what they were doing. I'd like to correct the part I wrote as though I witnessed it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Clarify that you only personally saw the car's scratches afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人が見たことと、友人から聞いたことを分けてお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish what you saw yourself from what your friend told you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 傷を見た時刻は午後五時ごろです。友人の話は四時ごろと聞きましたが、詳しい時刻は友人に確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人確認五時と友人話四時未照合を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saw the scratches at about five in the afternoon. I heard that my friend's account was from about four, but I haven't checked the exact time with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your five o'clock observation from the friend's unconfirmed four o'clock account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お友達の話は、そのまま引用だと分かるように残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep your friend's account clearly identified as a quotation of what they said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人の話として残します。本人へもう一度詳しく聞いた方がよいかも、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人から聞いたと明示し本人へ詳しく聞き直す必要があるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll keep it marked as my friend's account. I'd also like your advice on whether I should ask my friend again for more details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the account as something you heard from a friend and ask whether you should question them again in detail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元のメモと、訂正した内容を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show me the original note and your corrections.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: このメモです。私が傷を見たのは五時ごろで、人物の話は友人から聞いたものです。訂正した所も確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元メモと訂正を示し自身の観察時刻と伝聞の区別を確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is the note. I saw the scratches at about five, and the account about the person came from my friend. Could you check the corrected part too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the original note and corrections, and ask staff to check the distinction between your observation time and what you heard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。見た範囲と聞いた範囲を確認して伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hear your account while checking what you saw and what you were told.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の差出しでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この箱を再利用します。新しい宛名を貼りましたが、横に古い宛名が残っています。二つとも見えるまま出してよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再利用箱の新旧二宛名が見える状態を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm reusing this box. I've attached a new address label, but the old address is still on the side. I'd like to check whether I can send it with both visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending a reused box with both new and old address labels visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の送り先は、どちらのラベルでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which label is the destination for this shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の新しいラベルです。横は、この箱が前に私へ届いた時の物で、今回の送り先ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新ラベルが今回送り先で旧ラベルは過去受取と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The new label on top. The one on the side is from when this box was delivered to me before; it isn't this shipment's destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the new label is the current destination and the old label was for a previous delivery to you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い配送表示が紛らわしくならないよう、今回使う表示と区別して準備してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare the parcel so that the old shipping information cannot be confused with the information for this shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古いラベルを見えないようにして、新しい宛名だけ読める状態にします。こちらの準備場所で直していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古い表示を隠すため準備場所で直してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll cover the old label so only the new address can be read. May I fix it here in the preparation area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may use the preparation area to hide the old shipping information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでどうぞ。今回の差出人の表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use this area. Also check the sender information for this shipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 差出人は今の住所で書きました。引越し前の住所が古いラベルに残っているので、そちらも隠します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい差出人住所を示し旧住所も隠すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote my current address as the sender. My pre-move address is still on the old label, so I'll cover that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out your current sender address and say you will cover the old address too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備した表示を、封をした荷物と一緒にもう一度お示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show us the prepared labels again along with the sealed parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 古い表示を隠しました。新しい送り先と私の今の住所が読めるか、もう一度見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 準備後の荷物を示し今回の送り先と差出人表示の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've covered the old information. Could you check again whether the new destination and my current address are readable?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the prepared parcel and ask staff to check this shipment's recipient and sender information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今回の表示で差出し内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll check the shipment details using the current information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 残高の表示についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here to ask about the balance display?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここは百とあり、別の所には一万円とあります。合わせて一万百円とメモしましたが、百の横はドルでした。読み方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 百ドル表示を百円として円残高へ足したと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: This says one hundred, and elsewhere it says ten thousand yen. I noted a total of ten thousand one hundred yen, but the unit next to one hundred was dollars. I'd like to check how to read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you added a hundred-dollar display to a yen balance as though it were a hundred yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通貨の表示が違います。百ドルの表示を、百円としてそのまま足すことはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those are different currencies. You cannot simply add the hundred dollars as a hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百はドルだったんですね。円一万円と百ドルに分けてメモします。円に換算した表示も見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二通貨を分けてメモし円換算の表示が見られるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the hundred was in dollars. I'll record ten thousand yen and one hundred dollars separately. Can I also see a display converted into yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will record the two currencies separately and ask whether a yen-converted display is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 換算した表示を知りたい場合は、どの画面の何の目的か担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you'd like to see a converted display, please tell the person in charge which screen you mean and what you need it for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は両替したいわけではなく、残高を整理したいです。どの表示を見ればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 両替注文ではなく残高整理のため見る表示を案内してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm not trying to exchange money today; I want to organize my balances. Please tell me which display to look at.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you need guidance on the display to organize balances, not to place a currency exchange order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 以前の換算額のメモは、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have your previous note of the converted amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先月の換算メモはあります。今日の分も記録したいので、日付を付けて残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先月の記録があり今日の換算も日付付きで残したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have last month's conversion note. I'd like to record today's amount too, so I'll keep it with the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have last month's record and want to keep today's conversion with its date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の表示について、担当が確認します。換算の条件もお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check the current display. Please ask about the conversion conditions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この二つの残高と先月のメモを見せます。今日の換算表示を確認したいので、担当の方へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二通貨の残高と過去メモを示し今日の表示確認を担当へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show these two balances and last month's note. I'd like to check today's converted display, so please refer me to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the two currency balances and past note, and ask the person in charge to check today's display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示の確認として担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the person in charge to check the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買物のほかに、何かご用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need anything besides your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引越しで使う段ボールを探しています。空き箱を分けていただける場合はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越し用の空き段ボールを分けてもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for cardboard boxes for moving. Do you ever give away empty boxes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can have some empty cardboard boxes for moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。どのくらいの大きさをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person in charge. What size are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本を入れたいので、大きすぎない箱が二つあると助かります。大きい一箱だと重くなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本用に重すぎない小さめの二箱を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're for books, so two boxes that aren't too large would help. One large box would probably get heavy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for two smaller boxes for books so they will not become too heavy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱の状態と数を確認します。今日、お持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the boxes' condition and number. Will you take them home today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、歩いて来ました。大きいままでは持ちにくいので、たたんで持ち帰ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 徒歩で来たためたたんで持ち帰れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I walked here. They would be hard to carry at full size, so may I fold them up to take home?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you came on foot and ask whether you can take the boxes home folded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しできる箱があれば、たたむ場所もご案内します。ほかに希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: If there are boxes we can give you, we'll also show you where to fold them. Do you have any other preferences?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ぬれたり破れたりしていないものが希望です。本を入れる前に、自宅で底の状態も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乾いて破れのない箱を希望し使用前に底も自宅で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like boxes that aren't wet or torn. Before putting books in them, I also want to check the bottoms at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for dry, untorn boxes and say you will check their bottoms at home before use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 使用できるかはご自身でも確認してください。ご用意できる数は担当からお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check for yourself whether they are usable. The person in charge will tell you how many are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二つが難しければ一つでも構いません。提供できるかと、費用が必要かを確認してから頂きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一箱でもよいと譲歩し提供可否と費用条件の確認後に受け取りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. If two aren't possible, one is fine. I'd like to receive them after checking whether you can provide them and whether there is a charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept one box if necessary and say you want to confirm availability and cost conditions before accepting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。箱の状態と数、提供の条件を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll ask the person in charge about the boxes' condition, number, and conditions for providing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 観察の記録はできましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished your observation record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鳥の声を三回と書きましたが、途中でスマホの見本の声を再生していました。数え直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本音声の再生中に数えたため声の回数を訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote that I heard bird calls three times, but I was playing a sample call on my phone partway through. I'd like to count them again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to correct the call count because you counted while a sample recording was playing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 再生する前に聞こえた声はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you hear any calls before playing the recording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最初の一回は再生前に聞きました。後の二回はスマホの音だったかもしれません。どう記録すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 再生前一回と不確かな二回を説明し記録方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard the first one before playing it. The later two might have been the phone's sound. How should I record this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the one call before playback and two uncertain calls, and ask how to record them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確かに聞いた分と確認できない分を分けて、メモしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please record separately what you definitely heard and what you cannot confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一回は現地で聞き、後の二回は不明と書き足します。再生は止めましたが、記録の用紙をもう一枚頂けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確実と不明を追記し再生停止後に新しい記録用紙を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll add that I heard one call here and that the later two are uncertain. I've stopped playback, but could I have another recording sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add which calls are certain and uncertain, then ask for a new sheet after stopping playback. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。鳥の姿も見えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here you are. Did you see the bird as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 姿は見ていません。声の名前も分からないので、次に聞こえたら一緒に聞いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 姿未確認で種類も不明なので次の声を一緒に聞いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't seen it. I don't know what kind of call it was either, so I'd like you to listen with me if I hear it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you did not see the bird and do not know its species, and ask someone to listen with you to the next call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一緒に聞きましょう。次の観察地点へ移るまで、ここで待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's listen together. Can you wait here until we move to the next observation point?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、ここで少し聞きます。友人は先へ歩いていったので、次の地点で合流すると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 観察地点で待ち先に行った友人へ次の合流場所を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll listen here for a little while. My friend has walked ahead, so I'll let them know we'll meet at the next point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait at the observation point and tell the friend who went ahead where to meet next. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。次の地点はこちらの地図でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check this map for the next point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅れの案内をご覧になっていましたか。お乗りになる列車はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you looking at the delay information? Have you decided which train to take?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 九時十分の列車を待っています。降りる駅に同僚が車で迎えに来るので、どのくらい遅れるか知らせたいんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 迎えの同僚への連絡のため利用列車の遅れを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm waiting for the 9:10 train. A colleague is picking me up by car at my destination station, so I want to tell them how late it will be.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your train's delay so you can inform the colleague picking you up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その列車は、今のところ約二十分の遅れです。ただ、到着時刻まではまだ確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: That train is currently about twenty minutes late. Its arrival time has not yet been confirmed, though.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 迎えの場所は長く駐車できないそうです。二十分後に出発すると伝えてしまっても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐車制約を説明し遅延時間を発車時刻として伝えてよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Apparently they can't park for long at the pickup spot. Is it okay if I tell them the train will depart in twenty minutes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the parking restriction and ask whether you can communicate the delay duration as a departure time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発車をお約束できる時刻ではありません。「二十分ほど遅れている」と、現在の状況としてお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot promise departure at that time. Please describe the current situation as “it's running about twenty minutes late.”

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、同僚にはまだ家を出ずに待ってもらいます。列車が来たら、乗れたことを連絡する形にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同僚の出発を待ってもらい乗車後に連絡する案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll ask my colleague to wait at home for now. I'll let them know I've boarded when the train arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suggest asking your colleague to delay leaving and contacting them after boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでしたら、到着駅も伝えておくとよいですね。反対側のホームにも列車が来ますので、行き先をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, it would also be good to tell them your arrival station. Trains use the opposite platform too, so check their destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の放送が聞き取れませんでした。こちらのホームで待ち続けていいんですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聞き取れなかった放送を受け待つホームを聞き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I couldn't make out the announcement just now. Should I keep waiting on this platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask again which platform to wait on because you could not understand the announcement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、九時十分の列車はこちらです。反対側は逆方向ですので、そのままこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the 9:10 train is here. The opposite side is for the other direction, so please continue waiting here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。遅れていることだけ先に送り、この列車に乗ってから同僚に迎えをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の遅延と乗車後の迎え依頼を分けて連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll first just send a message that it's delayed, then ask my colleague to pick me up after I board this train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to communicate the current delay separately from the pickup request after boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちになる列車はこちらで間違いありません。案内に変更があれば、改めて放送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're definitely in the right place for your train. If the information changes, we'll announce it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約をご希望ですね。お持ちの通知についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like an appointment for a consultation, correct? Is it about the notice you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この通知の説明を聞きたいんですが、平日は仕事中なので、予約の電話を受けられないことがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談予約の連絡を仕事中に受けられない事情を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like an explanation of this notice, but I'm working on weekdays, so sometimes I can't answer calls about the appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you may be unable to answer a consultation appointment call while working. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当から折り返す形です。電話に出られる時間帯を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person in charge will call you back. May I ask what times you can answer the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼休みの十二時から十二時半なら出られます。留守番電話に、折り返す番号も入れてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 応答できる昼休みと留守電への番号記録を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can answer during my lunch break from twelve to twelve thirty. Could they also leave their callback number in my voicemail?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the lunch break when you can answer and ask for the callback number to be left in voicemail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望はお伝えできます。この通知の番号ではなく、相談担当の番号に折り返していただく予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can pass on your request. You'll be asked to call the consultation officer's number, rather than the number on this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、担当の番号をここに書いてください。留守番電話だけだと、数字を聞き間違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 数字の聞き違いを避けるため担当の番号を書いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please write the officer's number here. If it's only on voicemail, I might mishear the digits.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the officer's number in writing to avoid mishearing the digits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが担当の番号です。相談当日、説明を聞く際に言語の支援はご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is their number. Would you like language support when receiving the explanation on the consultation day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベトナム語で相談できると助かります。支援のある日に合わせるので、その点も担当者に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ベトナム語支援のある日を優先したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would help if I could consult in Vietnamese. I'll arrange it for a day when support is available, so please tell the officer that too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to prioritize a day when Vietnamese language support is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承りました。支援の手配ができる日と予約の空きは、担当からお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. The officer will tell you which days support can be arranged and which appointment slots are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それでは、昼休みに連絡を待ちます。出られなかったら、メモしていただいた番号へ私から折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昼休みの連絡待ちと不在時の折り返しを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll wait for a call during my lunch break. If I miss it, I'll call back myself using the number you've written down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to wait for the lunchtime call and call back if you miss it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡方法と言語のご希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。通知は相談の日までお手元に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on your contact preferences and language request. Please keep the notice until the consultation day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計後の書類についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the documents after payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。領収書の名前が私ではありません。受け取ってから気づいたので、確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書の名が自分と違うため会計へ確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The receipt doesn't have my name on it. I noticed after receiving it; could you check it for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the payment desk to check a receipt that bears someone else's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類はこちらで確認します。お客様のお名前が分かるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the document here. Do you have something showing your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この診察券です。間違った領収書は、このままお返しします。ほかの方の内容なので、写真には撮っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察券を示し別人の領収書を撮影せず返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my patient card. I'll return the incorrect receipt as it is. Since it contains someone else's information, I haven't photographed it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your patient card and say you are returning another person's receipt without photographing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ご自身のお支払いの控えもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. Do you also have a record of your own payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードのお控えがあります。金額は同じように見えますが、私の会計と合っているかも確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード控えを出し金額が似ていても自分の支払との照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my card payment slip. The amount looks the same, but I'd also like you to check whether it matches my payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your card slip and ask for a match to your own payment even though the amounts look similar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類と支払記録を照合します。ほかに受け取った物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll compare the document with the payment records. Did you receive anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約票もありますが、そちらは私の名前です。確認が済むまで、予約票は自分で持っていてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分名義の予約票は手元に残してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also have an appointment slip, but that one has my name. May I keep it with me until you finish checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may keep the appointment slip bearing your own name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞお持ちください。領収書の確認が済んだらお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep it. We'll call you when we've finished checking the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。正しい書類を受け取ったら、名前と日付を見直したいので、その場で確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照合を待ち訂正書類をその場で名前日付確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here. When I receive the correct document, I'd like to check the name and date again, so please let me check it on the spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the comparison and ask to check the corrected document's name and date there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。診察券とカード控え、領収書を照合してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll compare the patient card, card payment slip, and receipt, then assist you.
